source_title: Tata Safari EV, Hyundai Ioniq P, VinFast VF5 And Mahindra BE7: Upcoming EVs
source_excerpt:
The next wave of electric cars is coming soon, with a focus on the affordable end of the market, although some premium products are also on the way.
The VinFast VF5 and the Hyundai Ioniq P would cater to the affordable end of the market. Both would be small electric SUVs with sufficiently large battery packs to offer a good enough range.
The Hyundai Ioniq P would be the brand's most affordable electric car and would be made in India, with localisation also expected to help keep pricing affordable. It would be under 4 metres in length.
The next product is the VinFast VF5, which would be positioned below the VF6 as an affordable EV. It will also feature aggressive, sharp styling.
High-end premium EVs will also be introduced, with Mahindra and Tata continuing to launch new electric cars in this space.
The Mahindra BE7, for example, would be a new, radical but more family-focused EV than the BE6. It would be the fourth electric vehicle from Mahindra's Born Electric family. Its styling would remain close to the concept and retain a futuristic look.
The Harrier EV has been fairly successful, and Tata is now aiming to enter the three-row segment with the Safari EV, which will be positioned above the Harrier EV.
The Safari EV is expected to use the same battery pack and motor configuration as the Harrier EV. However, it will take a more comfort-oriented approach rather than focusing on performance, as the Harrier EV already caters to that aspect.
These are some of the EVs expected to launch soon across the affordable and premium segments, with more electric cars also set to arrive later in the year as EVs become more mainstream.
The VinFast VF5 and Hyundai Ioniq P are coming soon. Both are small electric SUVs designed to be affordable with sufficiently large battery packs for good range.
The Hyundai Ioniq P will be the brand's most affordable electric car, manufactured in India. It will be under 4 meters in length, with localization helping to keep its price low.
Mahindra is developing the family-focused BE7 as its fourth Born Electric vehicle. Tata is launching the three-row Safari EV, positioned above its Harrier EV.
